meta.notes: A elm hanging sign: under a block it hangs on two chains (on one bar when the block above is too narrow), and placed against a side it becomes the generated wall hanging sign msm_examples:elm_hanging_sign_wall on a bracket. Its board is drawn from the stripped log; the writing screen shows textures/gui/hanging_signs/elm_hanging_sign.png, which the flow saves. It stacks to 16.
